name: Pretense
description: Faerie substitute for Abilities; faeries buy Pretenses with points like Ability points and need no Virtues to have them.

name: Faerie Might
description: A faerie's spiritual strength; player faeries begin at 5, and it grants innate Magic Resistance equal to the score.

name: Might Points
description: Points equal to a faerie's Might score, spent to activate powers and normally fully recovered over 24 hours.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance to supernatural effects; Faerie Might grants it innately, though faerie bodies and props are not blocked by it.

name: Glamour
description: The mystical force by which faeries arrange matter into bodies and props, and which defines their taboos.

name: Cognizance
description: A faerie's level of awareness of its own nature, which governs its goals and its capacity to change roles or develop powers.

name: Taboo
description: A symbolic object or action that repels a faerie, defined in its glamour; every faerie character must have one.

name: Folk Charms
description: Trinkets and signs made to repel faeries, such as the Italian finger sign or Greek painted eyes; a class of faerie taboo.

name: Iron
description: A supremely magical metal woven into many faerie stories as a ward, though miners, crafters and urban faeries often tolerate it.

name: Religious Symbols
description: A class of faerie taboo; such faeries flee church bells, and many powerful faeries cannot enter the Dominion uninvited.

name: Intricacy Points
description: Points representing complex portions of a faerie's glamour, used to raise a power's Initiative or reduce its Might cost.

name: Until (Duration)
description: A Duration lasting until a certain thing occurs; treated as equivalent to Year but not requiring a Ritual.

name: Constant Powers
description: Greater, Lesser or Personal Powers made to trigger automatically at sunrise and sunset, costing Might each time.

name: Faerie Power
description: Spell-like powers of faeries designed via Virtues, activated by spending Might Points, with Penetration based on Might.

name: Vis
description: Magical substance; faeries of greater Might contain more vis, and using the vis from a faerie's anchor destroys it permanently.

name: Anchor
description: The seat of a faerie's spiritual essence; if its vis is used the faerie is permanently dead.

name: Arcane Connection
description: A mystical link between objects and people; faeries can see them and need them to use powers beyond Touch in other Realms' areas.

name: Aura
description: The prevailing supernatural aura, which affects faerie Might recovery and regeneration time via the Realm Interaction Table.

name: Regeneration
description: Faerie bodies regenerate as suits their story; if killed they rebuild a body over months based on Might and Aura.

name: Permanent Death
description: Faeries are permanently killed only by forces outside their story, such as destruction of Might, miracles, Infernal agents, or use of anchor vis.

name: Equipment Without Encumbrance
description: Faeries suffer no Encumbrance for traditional props, which are made of glamour and can be reconstituted.

name: Size
description: Score for body size affecting Characteristics and wound penalties; humanoid faeries choose from Size +2 to -3 normally.

name: Social Interaction Virtues and Flaws
description: Faerie Virtues and Flaws governing interaction with humans that replace Social Status Virtues.

name: Personality Flaws
description: Faeries may have up to three Minor and one Major Personality Flaw, often tied to their form or role.

name: Confidence
description: Faeries do not have Confidence scores, lacking the internal spark of inspiration.

name: Decrepitude
description: Aging effect that faeries cannot suffer unless they have a Flaw.

name: The Gift
description: Faeries may not have The Gift or any Virtue or Flaw specific to Hermetic magi.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic Magic Resistance which does not block faerie bodies or props.

name: Penetration
description: For a faerie power, Might Score minus five times Might cost plus Penetration bonus.

name: Spell Mastery
description: At storyguide discretion, Improved Powers can grant mastery-like special abilities for a faerie power.

name: Faerie Lore
description: Human knowledge of faeries learned through experience; few faeries possess it.

name: Awareness
description: Ability used with Faerie Sight and to detect supernatural aid or weapons.

name: Brawl
description: Ability used for attacks with natural weapons such as teeth, claws, horns and hooves.

name: Single Weapon
description: Combat Ability; an example faerie sword grants +2 to it through Grant Puissance.

name: Faerie Speech
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue (also a Pretense) letting a faerie speak whatever language its audience speaks, at no Might cost.

name: Living Language
description: Language Ability; a human typically begins with Living Language 5.

name: Fast Might Recovery
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a faerie restore its entire Might Pool in six hours.

name: Feast of the Fae
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a faerie recover 5 Might by receiving traditional sacrifices from humans, once per day.

name: Feast of the Dead
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a faerie recover 2 Might after draining a Long Term Fatigue level or causing a Medium Wound to a human.

name: Increased Faerie Might
description: Major or Minor Supernatural Virtue increasing Might by 15 or 5 respectively.

name: Time or Place of Power
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue making Might 10 higher at a time or place linked to the faerie's role.

name: Huge
description: Major General Virtue (faeries only) making the character far larger, adjusting Size, Characteristics and Body levels.

name: External Vis
description: Minor or Major Supernatural Virtue placing the faerie's anchor in a traditional prop that can be carried far from its body.

name: Faerie Beast
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue: the character appears to be an animal with all advantages of a faerie body.

name: Faerie Sight
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting faeries tell glamour from mundane, see Arcane Connections and read each other's glamour.

name: Humanoid Faerie
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue giving a material body of roughly human shape.

name: Hybrid Form
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue giving a body mixing human and animal elements.

name: Immune to (Source of Damage)
description: Minor or Major Supernatural Virtue making a faerie take no damage from a nominated force such as cold, fire or iron.

name: Improved Damage
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue enhancing a natural weapon by up to +5 Damage.

name: Improved Initiative
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue increasing a natural weapon's Initiative by 3.

name: Improved Soak
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue increasing Soak by 2; may be taken more than once.

name: Puissant Pretense
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue giving +2 to rolls with a particular Pretense.

name: Residual Power
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue automatically triggering a faerie power when the body is destroyed.

name: Positive Folktales
description: Minor Social Interaction Virtue: the faerie type is in local folklore and treated with respect and caution.

name: Infiltrator
description: Minor or Major Social Interaction Virtue for a faerie that lives as a human, costing as the mimicked Social Status.

name: Passes for Human
description: Free Social Interaction choice: the faerie suffers no social consequences as it can seem human, living at society's margins.

name: Narrowly Cognizant
description: Free Supernatural choice: the faerie can improve itself in ways traditional for its type.

name: Highly Cognizant
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue: the faerie knows creative humans can change faeries and seeks such change.

name: Reputation as Confidence
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue giving false Confidence points equal to the faerie's highest Reputation, spent on rolls supporting it.

name: Focus Power
description: Major Supernatural Virtue granting 25 spell levels for fluid spontaneous-like effects within a theme.

name: Greater Power
description: Major Supernatural Virtue granting 50 spell levels of formulaic-like powers with Might cost magnitude/2.

name: Lesser Power
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting formulaic-like powers costing Might equal to magnitude.

name: Personal Power
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting 25 levels for a Personal-range power.

name: Ritual Power
description: Major Supernatural Virtue granting 25 levels of ritual effects, which also reduce Might Score when used.

name: Improved Powers
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue giving 5 intricacy points to spend on powers.

name: Pretentious
description: Virtue that may change the multiplier for Pretense points.

name: Ostentatious
description: Virtue that may change the multiplier for Pretense points.

name: Tough
description: Virtue suited to humans that many combat-oriented faeries also take.

name: Common Sense
description: Virtue whose storyguide advice mechanism is echoed by a faerie guidance power.

name: Puissant (Single Weapon)
description: Virtue popularly granted by faeries through Grant (Minor Virtue).

name: Decreased Might
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the faerie has only 1 point of Might instead of 5.

name: Restricted Might
description: Major or Minor Supernatural Flaw rendering the faerie nearly powerless under certain conditions.

name: Slow Might Recovery
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: the faerie recovers only one Might Point per day.

name: Might Recovery Requires Vitality
description: Major Supernatural Flaw requiring rest and a meal in a human community to regain Might.

name: Little
description: Major General Flaw (faeries only) making the character far smaller.

name: Intangible Flesh
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: the character is immaterial and cannot physically influence the world.

name: Poor Combatant
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: loses 2 Attack and Defense with one combat Pretense.

name: Reduced Damage
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw decreasing a natural weapon's Damage by 2.

name: Reduced Initiative
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw decreasing a natural weapon's Initiative by 3.

name: Reduced Soak
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw reducing Soak by 2 due to contact with a Ward.

name: Role Requires Suffering
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the faerie feels pain and suffers wound penalties like a human.

name: Susceptible to Deprivation
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the faerie suffers human consequences without air, food and water.

name: Vulnerable to (Substance)
description: Minor or Major Supernatural Flaw giving Soak 0 against a particular substance.

name: Monstrous Appearance
description: Major Social Interaction Flaw giving -6 in social situations where appearance matters.

name: Negative Reaction
description: Minor Social Interaction Flaw giving -3 on all social rolls.

name: Incognizant
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the faerie is unaware it can change its role.

name: Traditional Ward
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the faerie cannot touch things protected by its ward, which burns it and blocks Might regeneration.

name: Sovereign Ward
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: the faerie cannot harm anyone defended by its ward and is destroyed by its touch.

name: Aloof
description: Flaw that may change the multiplier for Pretense points.

name: Noncombatant
description: Flaw that combat-limiting faerie Flaws must not merely duplicate.

name: Dark Secret
description: Flaw suggested for Infiltrators whose faerie nature would destroy their status.

name: Dwarf
description: Mortal Flaw that faeries may not take.

name: Giant Blood
description: Mortal Virtue/Flaw that faeries may not take.

name: Reduced Power
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw subtracting 5 intricacy points from a faerie's powers.

name: Slow Power
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw requiring an extra round of preparation for a power.

name: Binding Oath
description: Ritual faerie power (Vim) enforcing a solemnly sworn oath; oathbreakers are warned and then suffer a Flaw.

name: Grant (Major Virtue)
description: Ritual faerie power (Vim) imposing a named Major Virtue on a target, temporarily or permanently.

name: Grant (Minor Virtue)
description: Ritual faerie power (Vim) imposing a named Minor Virtue; many faerie enchanted objects use it.

name: Grant (Major Flaw)
description: Ritual faerie power (Vim) imposing a named Major Flaw as a curse.

name: Grant (Minor Flaw)
description: Ritual faerie power (Vim) imposing a named Minor Flaw upon a victim.

name: Adhere
description: Faerie power (Corpus) preventing a rider from dismounting a faerie animal, as with kelpies.

name: Allure
description: Faerie power (Mentem) granting +3 to impress or convince others.

name: Cause Fatigue
description: Faerie power causing a human to lose a fatigue level.

name: Cause Drowsiness
description: Faerie power (Corpus or Animal) causing a touched human to fall asleep.

name: Cause Sickness
description: Faerie power (Corpus) causing a serious illness by touch or poisoning objects.

name: Craft Magical Trinket
description: Faerie power creating a glamour object letting its holder use a particular Virtue once.

name: Damaging Effect
description: Faerie power making the faerie's glamour weapons deal +5 Damage for two minutes.

name: Eidolon
description: Faerie power (Imaginem) creating a visible and audible illusory form directed by the faerie.

name: Enthralling Sound
description: Faerie power (Mentem) creating a chosen emotion in a group that hears it.

name: Enthrallment
description: Faerie power (Mentem) taking complete control of a human's mind for a day through eye contact.

name: Fearful Flaming Eyes
description: Faerie power (Corpus) paralyzing a human who makes eye contact.

name: Grant Puissance in (Ability)
description: Faerie power (Corpus) granting bonuses to humans' rolls in an activity.

name: Loosely Material
description: Minor faerie power suited to immaterial faeries.

name: Circular Ward Against the Faeries of the Wood
description: Hermetic spell targeting the material a faerie is made from, effective against faeries.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Hermetic spell targeting the spiritual nature of faeries, effective against them.

name: Enslave the Mortal Mind
description: ReMe spell used as the model for the Enthrallment faerie power.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form associated with faerie powers for Magic Resistance purposes.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Form associated with faerie powers for Magic Resistance purposes.

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Form associated with faerie powers for Magic Resistance purposes.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form associated with faerie powers for Magic Resistance purposes.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Form associated with faerie powers for Magic Resistance purposes.

name: Faerie
description: The realm of faeries, spirits that draw matter about themselves with glamour.

name: Dominion
description: Divine realm; many powerful faeries cannot enter it uninvited by God.

name: Infernal
description: Realm whose agents can destroy faeries; faeries may not have its powers.

name: Magic
description: Realm whose elemental spirits also build bodies of matter; faeries may not have its powers.

name: Arcadia
description: Faerie otherworld to which seemingly dead faeries may be dispelled for millennia.

name: House Merinita
description: Hermetic House studying faeries; its magi theorize about faerie death and Until durations.

name: House Bjornaer
description: Hermetic House whose chapter gives rules for mundane animals.

name: Summer Court
description: Faerie court that makes war on the Winter Court at the Equinox.

name: Winter Court
description: Faerie court that makes war on the Summer Court at the Equinox.

name: Mongols
description: Invaders whose siege of a covenant is an example use of mass trinkets.

name: Black Terrors
description: Faeries with typical Might 1.

name: Kubu
description: Faerie with typical Might 1.

name: Brownie
description: Household faerie with low Might; one type is completed and moves on when given clothes.

name: Centaur
description: Faerie with typical Might 5.

name: Dwarf (Faerie)
description: Faerie with typical Might 5 that may seek to become a dwarf king.

name: Faerie Dog
description: Faerie with typical Might 5.

name: Faun
description: Faerie with typical Might 5.

name: Kelpie
description: Faerie animal with Might 5 that uses Adhere against riders.

name: Satyr
description: Faerie with typical Might 5.

name: Sprite
description: Faerie with typical Might 5.

name: Barking Beast
description: Faerie with typical Might 10.

name: Glanconer
description: Faerie with typical Might 10.

name: Minor Knight
description: Faerie with typical Might 10.

name: Triton
description: Faerie with typical Might 10.

name: Unicorn
description: Faerie with typical Might 10.

name: Mormo
description: Moderately powerful faerie, Might 11-20.

name: Orm
description: Faerie dragon-like being whose Might varies with Size, from 11-20 up to 35.

name: Ghula
description: Faerie with typical Might 20.

name: Valkyrie
description: Faerie with typical Might 20.

name: Faerie Champion
description: Faerie with typical Might 25.

name: Gorgon
description: Faerie with typical Might 25.

name: Fachan
description: Faerie with typical Might 30.

name: Faerie Noble
description: Faerie with typical Might 35.

name: Lamia
description: Faerie with typical Might 35.

name: Lamashtu
description: Extremely powerful faerie with Might 45.

name: Jinn
description: Faeries released from bottles who offer three wishes followed by death.

name: Dragon
description: Minor, major and great dragons span Might 31-75.

name: Jove
description: Pagan deity given as an earth-shaking faerie figure of Might 51-75.

name: Black Faced Hermes
description: Faerie figure listed in the Might table with no applicable Might score.

name: Yallery Brown
description: Faerie released from under a stone who worked in gratitude, then tormented his master to death after being thanked.

name: Thor
description: God to whom a tree was once sacred; on the Isle of Man it and a Thor's-hammer fishbone still ward off faeries.

name: Witch Bottles
description: Folk charms of Yorkshire that repel faeries.

name: Isle of Man
description: Place where a tree once sacred to Thor and a fishbone charm ward off faeries.

name: Italy
description: Place where people make a finger sign as a folk charm.

name: Greece
description: Place where people paint eyes as a charm against the evil eye.

name: Yorkshire
description: Region whose faeries are repelled by witch bottles.

name: Alps
description: Region where wild mountain roses repel vampiric faeries.

name: The Abandoned Shrine
description: Scenery story element with random-generation tables.
